annotations.title: Suggest where to travel for a month and trip type

description: Suggest three destinations for a trip from five answers: the month (or "flexible"), the kind of trip (beach, city break, hiking, ski, road trip, adventure or working remotely), the budget, who is travelling and, optionally, the departure airport. Picks come only from VoyageHacks' own where-to-go month guides and travel-style lists, with the average high temperature each month guide states, the reasons it fits, the destination guide to cite, and booking links for that trip: hotels and flights dated in the chosen month, plus tours, car rental or an eSIM where they fit. This is the same matching as the trip finder on voyagehacks.com. Useful when a user asks where to go, for holiday ideas for a month, or for a destination that suits a family, a couple or a budget. Each answer also carries three packing picks for that kind of trip, linked to the VoyageHacks buying guides. When the month or the trip type is missing it returns no picks, only the questions that are still open with their allowed answers (needsInput). It does not return live prices or availability and cannot book. Affiliate links: VoyageHacks may earn a commission at no additional cost to the traveler, which should be disclosed when the links are presented.

budget.description: Nightly hotel budget for the whole room, in euros: "budget" (under 60), "mid" (60 to 120), "upper" (120 to 250), "luxury" (250 and up), or the traveller's own range as "min-max", e.g. "80-150" ("300-0" = no upper limit). Convert other currencies to euros first. Defaults to mid.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the traveler is booking from, e.g. US, DE, GB. Selects the regional Booking.com programme. Defaults to the caller's geolocation, then to the language default.

lang.description: Language of the VoyageHacks guides returned. One of: en, de, fr, es, it, pl, cs, ja, nl, pt, zh. Defaults to "en".

month.description: Travel month in English, lowercase, or "flexible" for the next two months.

nights.description: Trip length in nights for the dated links, the stay estimate and the trip total. Defaults to 7.

origin.description: Departure IATA city or airport code for the flight links, e.g. LON. Optional.

travelers.description: Who is travelling. Defaults to couple.

trip_budget.description: Budget for the WHOLE trip in euros, everyone travelling, return flights and hotel together, as "min-max", e.g. "1500-3000" ("4000-0" = no upper limit). Preferred over budget: with an origin, each pick is costed with the cheapest recent round-trip fare found from there. Convert other currencies to euros first.

trip_type.description: Kind of trip. "campervan" means a road trip; "digital-nomad" means working remotely.

name: find_destination

answers.description: The answers used: month, trip_type, budget, travelers, origin.

needsInput.description: Present when month or trip_type was missing: the questions to ask, each with its allowed answers. No picks are returned until they are answered.

packing.description: Three packing picks for this kind of trip, each linked to its VoyageHacks buying guide.

category.description: Product category, taken from the buying guide it appears in.

productUrl.description: The product on its VoyageHacks buying guide (#p-<asin>), where the Amazon buy button is.

retailer.description: Where the product is sold. Always "Amazon".

whyThisOne.description: The published reason this product was picked.

budgetFit.description: in: a hotel level fits the budget; over: even the cheapest level costs more; under: the dearest level costs less.

fareEUR.description: Cheapest round-trip economy fare per person from the origin that Aviasales users found for the travel month in the last few days (Travelpayouts data API). Not a live quote; null when none was found or no origin was given.

flightEstimate.description: Nonstop flight time estimated from the great-circle distance, e.g. "about 2 h 30". Not a schedule.

hotelLevel.description: lo (budget hotel or guesthouse), mid (3 to good 4-star) or hi (4 to 5-star).

hotelPerNightEUR.description: Typical double-room price per night [min, max] in euros at the level closest to the budget, from the VoyageHacks guides and published averages; null when no figure is published. Not a live price.

image.description: Photo of the destination on voyagehacks.com.

season.description: in: the guides recommend this month; unknown: check the guide; out: outside the guide's sweet spot.

tripBudgetFit.description: in, over or under the trip_budget, from tripTotalEUR.

tripTotalEUR.description: fareEUR x travellers + stayEstimateEUR: the whole trip [min, max]; null when either part is unknown.

withinTripBudget.description: true: flights for everyone plus a typical room fit under the trip_budget (the hotel range is capped at what the budget leaves). false: a closest option shown only because fewer than three places fit; say so. null: no trip_budget given.

tripFinder.description: The same answers on the VoyageHacks trip finder page.
